oracle.title: Oracle AI
oracle.description:
Oracle AI is an artificial intelligence on discord that is capable of long term memory, tool usage, and more!
Oracle has been trained on datasets such as community submissions, wikipedia articles, and other sources, giving it the unique ability to learn and comment about fictional stories and events as soon as they happen!

features.title: Varying Personality
features.description: Oracle will vary its personality based on how you speak to it, the message rating system is used to change oracle's personality over time

features.title: Long Term Memory
features.description: Oracle is able to recall a large amount of memories based on selected inputs by its developers, community inputs, webscraping, and more!

features.title: Image Vision
features.description: Oracle can see and react to images you send it!

features.title: Accounts System
features.description: Users can pin messages to get Oracle to remember things about them or have a customised personality

bluemapwrapper.title: BlueMapWrapper
bluemapwrapper.description: BlueMapWrapper is a Python library that lets you easily interact with BlueMap Data, allowing you to easily parse markers, player locations, plugin data, and more!

features.title: Pythonic
features.description: BlueMapWrapper is made in a way that makes it very intuitive for Python

features.title: Object Oriented Design
features.description: BlueMapWrapper was designed with OOP design principles in mind, making it scalable and easy to understand

ratmod.title: Rat Mod
ratmod.description: Rat mod is a Minecraft Fabric mod that adds rats, cheese, and more into your game!

features.title: RATS!
features.description: Rat Mod adds rats into your game, these rats are attracted to cheese, and will naturally wonder to cheese blocks. These critters spawn naturally in caves, and are peaceful!

features.title: Cheese
features.description: Rat Mod adds cheese into your game, which is crafted from milk, and can be eaten or fed to breed rats!

parsegument.title: Parsegument
parsegument.description: Parsegument is a Python library that makes it easy to parse strings and execute functions from text inputs!

features.title: Link commands to functions
features.description: You can automatically execute functions from text inputs, Parsegument will automatically parse the arguments and pass their proper types to the function
